spec_match.rationale: Teaches the ManifestId join column exactly as specced: add() returns it in installedApps, list() resolves record<ManifestId, {appName}>, remove() consumes it and resolves {removedApps, failedApps}; the copy also carries the spec's id derivation (manifest id member, falling back to start_url) and the NotFoundError / OperationError removal failures from the current remove() algorithm.

interactive.rationale: list() and remove() buttons call the real API when bound; on this origin the labelled illustrative inventory renders, checkbox selection gates the remove button, and removal updates rows plus the live output.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises watching the identity flow end to end; the page's flow diagram, live table keyed by ManifestId, and remove-by-id round trip deliver that as a recognisable suite-settings pattern.

edge_cases.rationale: Unsupported branch labelled and separated from live results (table caption switches between 'live list() result' and 'illustrative sample — not a live result'), remove disabled with nothing selected, live rejection branches surfaced with exact DOMException names.

references.rationale: Links the chromestatus entry, the spec's remove() section, the official sample, and the sibling install-response-map.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite's list-resolves-record assertion pins the record (not array) shape this page's table iterates, and subapps-remove-method pins the method type; both honestly fail on non-IWA origins.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome via the repo CDP harness (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this cloud environment): list() clicked → honest unsupported message plus labelled illustrative caption asserted; remove verified disabled before selection, enabled after checkbox click; illustrative remove asserted ('No platform call was made') with the row count dropping 3→2; zero console errors/warnings, zero network failures; responsive screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Separate asserts for live vs fallback branches: subapps-list-live/-rejected/-unsupported and subapps-remove-live/-rejected/-illustrative — the illustrative path is never recorded as a platform success.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; secondary button overrides background AND color; disabled state visually distinct with cursor feedback; 24px checkboxes with label-wrapped id/name cells (the v150 tap-target fix, retained).

accessibility.rationale: Each checkbox has a visually-hidden per-app label plus label-wrapped ManifestId/appName cells for large tap targets; results announced via aria-live output; table caption states live vs illustrative so non-visual users get the same honesty cue; flow diagram is aria-hidden decoration with the same content in prose.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Measured post-interaction at 360×740 DPR3: scrollWidth=360 with the inventory table rendered; desktop 1280 exercised with the same script; feature-level responsive-check OK on both classes.

openQuestions.title: Confirm live remove() row-removal against a real IWA inventory
openQuestions.detail: The live branch (list() resolving real entries, remove() dropping only removedApps rows and reporting failedApps ids) is implemented per the spec's SubAppsRemoveResponse but has only executed against the labelled illustrative fallback here, because window.subApps cannot bind outside an isolated-app:// context. Verify the live path — including a NotFoundError failure for a stale id — when a ChromeOS 152 IWA environment is available.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status updates after button activation dynamic results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep programmatic state (captions, live regions, disabled states) synchronised with visual state at the moment of interaction.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The caption flips live/illustrative in the same render as the table, the output announces every branch, and the remove button's disabled state tracks selection via the change event.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: CDP interaction run 2026-08-16: disabled→enabled transition and caption text asserted.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table long identifiers narrow mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Let long unbreakable tokens wrap rather than widening the table.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: overflow-wrap:anywhere on result output and table cells, retained from the v150 fix for the unbroken payload-token overflow.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Mobile measurement 2026-08-16: scrollWidth=360 with table visible and remove message rendered.

summary: Adaptation of the v150 identity round trip for Chrome 152: copy reframed to enabled-by-default (no flag), spec id-derivation and removal-failure details added, and the practical suite-manager framing made explicit. The illustrative fallback remains clearly labelled and never fakes a platform result. All controls exercised headlessly with zero console errors; mobile and desktop matrix pass.
